subject: Web Development
title: Lazy Loading and Code Splitting
description: A quick win: understand Lazy Loading and Code Splitting.

hook.text: Why download a page's footer images before the user even scrolls past the hero?

buildup.text: Lazy loading delays non-critical resources until they're actually needed.

discovery.text: Code splitting breaks JavaScript into chunks loaded on demand, not all upfront.

twist.text: Native lazy loading landed in browsers in 2019. Before that, developers used JS libraries.

climax.text: Loading only what's needed, when it's needed, cuts initial page weight dramatically.

punchline.text: Don't load what the user hasn't asked for yet.

quiz.question: What does code splitting do?
options: Breaks JS into chunks loaded on demand
